handback.title: Tests are found and tagged by the test settings
handback.summary: Dokima finds, links and runs tests by the repo's test settings instead of fixed values.
handback.user_story: A repo's test tag, folder and run command decide which tests Dokima finds, links and runs.

acceptance_criteria.text: The repo's test tag setting decides which call links a test to its criterion.
acceptance_criteria.words: Which call links a test to its criterion is read from the test tag setting.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: A missing tag falls back to the shipped default, already tested.

acceptance_criteria.text: The planner's check finds tests written as methods of a test class.
acceptance_criteria.words: Dokima finds tests written as methods of a test class.

edge_cases.case: A class method test with no summary is still rejected for it.

acceptance_criteria.text: The planner's check finds tests written as async functions.
acceptance_criteria.words: Dokima finds tests written as async functions.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: One shape of test; a missing name is covered in its test.

acceptance_criteria.text: The planner's check finds tests indented under another block.
acceptance_criteria.words: Dokima finds tests indented under another block.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: One shape of test; a missing name is covered in its test.

acceptance_criteria.text: A pull request changing only prompt files gets the text-only check.
acceptance_criteria.words: Changes to Dokima's prompt folder no longer stop the text-only shortcut.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Other folders are covered by the next criterion.

acceptance_criteria.text: The repo's settings list the folders whose Markdown changes skip the text-only check.
acceptance_criteria.words: The folders that stop the text-only shortcut come from settings.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: A repo with no settings file keeps the shipped list.

acceptance_criteria.text: A manual fix's check runs the tests in the repo's test folder setting.
acceptance_criteria.words: The manual-fix check runs the tests in the test folder setting.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: No settings file still runs the default folder, in its test.

acceptance_criteria.text: The planner's check rejects any file outside the repo's test folder setting.
acceptance_criteria.words: The planner's check refuses files outside the test folder setting.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: A file inside the folder is shown as accepted in its test.

acceptance_criteria.text: The check that new tests fail today runs them from the repo's test folder setting.
acceptance_criteria.words: The planner's check lays the branch's test folder, from settings, over main.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: A failing test is shown as not reported in its test.

acceptance_criteria.text: The check that new tests fail today runs each one with the repo's run-one command.
acceptance_criteria.words: The check that new tests fail today runs each with the run-one command setting.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: A runner that fails is shown as accepted in its test.

test_changes.tests/test_text_only.py::test_a_pull_req: Owner asked that prompt folder changes no longer stop the text-only shortcut.
